source_stage.description: Normalize schema and types, impute missing values, remove constant/quasi-constant or duplicate columns, clip outliers, and define leakage-safe train/validation folds.
guarantees: Feature transforms can be fit without validation leakage.

source_stage_review.realization: Select explicit numeric/string column positions; validate finite values or nulls, fit numeric medians and clipping quantiles per outer training fold, screen constant/duplicate and modal-share quasi-constant columns, and validate caller-provided group-consistent folds.
source_stage_review.limits: Schema meaning and group discovery remain caller policy. No automatic chronology, duplicate-entity detection or general leakage guarantee. All-null numeric columns fill zero and are screened. Dense tables and wide-category resource use are not qualified.

source_stage.description: Create target/count/frequency encodings, category interactions, entity embeddings, LDA topic features from text-like fields, group/session/user aggregations, log transforms, outlier or feature clipping, RFE or permutation-selected features, and sparse or dense feature matrices inside folds.
guarantees: Feature rows align with labels and prediction rows.

source_stage_review.realization: Implement count/frequency and group-excluded target means, collision-free category-pair interactions, supervised categorical embedding vectors, training-only count-vocabulary LDA topics, explicit-key numeric aggregates, signed log1p copies, quantile clipping and RFE-selected dense features. Fit each feature family only within its outer training fold; preserve row order.
source_stage_review.limits: Empty specification lists explicitly disable inapplicable families; qualification exercises every family together. Text fields use explicit whitespace/case policy. Group aggregate keys are feature choices distinct from validation groups. Entity vectors use a binary MLP objective, full fitting-fold labels and zero vectors for unseen categories. RFE is the selected alternative to permutation selection. Only target means exclude each training row group; supervised embeddings and RFE use all fitting-fold labels. Fold coordinate systems need not align because only prediction columns are stacked.

source_stage.description: Train XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost with categorical support, ExtraTrees, RandomForest, sparse linear models, MLP/entity-embedding networks, TabNet, or TabPFN-style models with early stopping, class weights or SMOTE where appropriate, and metric-aware objectives.
guarantees: Every stacked model has out-of-fold predictions.

source_stage_review.realization: Select standardized logistic regression and ExtraTrees as two source-listed model-family branches for binary classification. Fit each independently per outer fold and produce one held-out probability from each model for every training row.
source_stage_review.limits: Other listed model families are alternatives and are not claimed. No SMOTE, class weighting, early stopping or hyperparameter search; caller chooses applicability and controls. Convergence warnings fail execution. ExtraTrees n_jobs and native pools are one.

source_stage.description: Blend, rank-average, or train a second-level stacker over out-of-fold predictions, optionally adding validation-safe pseudo-labeling or model selection by fold stability.

source_stage_review.realization: Select a second-level logistic stacker trained on the two OOF prediction columns. Refit base models and their feature maps on all training rows for later calibration and prediction.
source_stage_review.limits: No rank-average, pseudo-labeling or stability-based model selection is claimed. OOF coverage and group/fold separation are checked; OOF scores are training inputs to the stacker, not an independent evaluation of the final stacked model.

source_stage.description: Apply QWK threshold search, multi-class probability calibration, class-imbalance handling, rank normalization, regression clipping, inverse transforms, or benchmark-specific formatting.

source_stage_review.realization: Realize probability calibration for the explicit two-class specialization: fit a regularized sigmoid to clipped class-1 score logits on separated calibration rows, then return finite ordered query probabilities and inclusive 0.5 decisions.
source_stage_review.limits: This specializes the source probability-calibration family to binary classes; it does not implement arbitrary multiclass calibration, QWK search, regression transforms or a named benchmark file format. Generic result arrays preserve query order and duplicates. A fitted calibration procedure is not a guarantee of empirical calibration or accuracy. Native stored-original execution and publication remain pending.

remaining_requirements: Stage corrected original graph with exact approved bindings and immutable lineage.
Execute the stored original graph, verify source-scope fidelity, then run publication corruption and rollback checks.
Verify approved latest-version retrieval and served selection without changing the retained derivative.
limits: Explicit binary realization of the generic source topology; not every listed model or metric alternative.
All named feature families implemented with explicit applicability policies; original source does not prescribe a universal schema.
Automated synthetic qualification only; no historical winning-solution reproduction or Tier 1 human review.
